استحرما (form X)
# اِسْتَحْرَمَا (istaḥramā) /is.taħ.ra.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اُسْتُحْرِمَا (ustuḥrimā) /us.tuħ.ri.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرِمَا (istaḥrimā) /is.taħ.ri.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
